redistribution.license_summary: GPLv2 with Classpath Exception; OpenJDK Assembly Exception and bundled third-party notices

limitations: The detached signature and Adoptium public key were captured and hashed, but OpenPGP verification was not performed because no verifier is installed.
The official ZIP, installed JDK and generated jlink runtime are byte-bound, but this is not an independent reproducible-build audit of Adoptium's source build.
License, trademark, source-offer and third-party redistribution obligations still require named human sign-off before sale.
